coverage.reason: Validate the systemd monthly timer against the existing UTC realm-end contract across 15 months including leap February and daylight-saving boundaries. Exercise daily-schedule replacement, no off-schedule reboot catch-up, completion grace, existing-copy transition, stale local/cloud copies, failed/stalled backups, malformed/future timestamps and private HTTP 200/503/404 responses. The runbook and Master Specification record the confirmed schedule, recovery exposure and unchanged storage/retention. No game runtime, database export format, schema, reset rule, publisher or visual behavior changes; emulator suites, gameplay builds and full backup/restore drills are not applicable.
